name: SERP Watch Team
tagline: Watches where your brand surfaces in search and in AI answers
description: Rankings are only half the picture now that people put their questions to a chatbot instead. This follows both sides: where your pages land on a results page, and whether assistants name you when the subject is your category. That becomes a regular digest with a view on what to write next.
author: ShehjadTaus
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
